entities.name: René Sparenberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Sparenberg was a Dutch field hockey player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Born in Semarang, Dutch East Indies, he was a member of the Dutch field hockey team, which won the bronze medal. He played all five matches as forward.
